text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Early one morning, Air Groove is waiting outside the academy gate.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Morning, Air Groove! You're quite the early bird today!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. I woke up feeling quite refreshed, so I thought it would be nice to say good morning to everyone.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I'll join you! I'm on the disciplinary committee, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Heh, it'd be a pleasure to have you here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove and Bamboo Memory's lively greetings echo across the academy.
